description: This source file defines the MediaStorageManager class, which manages media files in an Android application. It includes functions to list, delete, clean up unused media, and create new media files, supporting image, video, and audio types.

classes.name: MediaStorageManager
classes.description: Manages storage of media files, supporting listing, creation, cleanup, and deletion of media files in the app's private storage.

methods.name: listMediaFiles
methods.description: Lists all media files present in the designated media folder.

methods.name: deleteAllMedia
methods.description: Deletes all media files within the media folder recursively.

methods.name: cleanUpStorage
methods.description: Removes media files that are not referenced in any notes' attachments.

methods.name: createMediaFile
methods.description: Creates a new media file of specified type and returns its URI and File object.
